name: lamp-room
description: A closed room at midnight lit by two steady lamps (roadmap R86): a warm globe of 40 cd hanging over the table and a blue one of 25 cd on the far wall, each a point light of its own colour in the frame's lights and an emissive globe whose luminance is the lamp's, the table and the cupboard casting their shadows under --shadows rt and none under --shadows csm. A lantern prop declaring the same warm lamp is there for a game to place (engine-view --game). The camera path holds in the doorway's corner looking at the table (README.md).
